voter_harm_risk: voters miss deadline or correction because notice is jargon-heavy, inaccessible, or available only as an image/PDF
usability_floor: plain-language summary, machine-readable timestamp, accessible text, digest, and correction status are available together
required_checks: plain-language review; heading structure; keyboard access; screen-reader text; no image-only notice; correction link present
synthetic_status: synthetic usability floor only; no local notice approval
public_boundary: A digest-correct notice is not ready for voters until its public language and access path are reviewed.
non_claims: not current voter instruction; not legal advice; not accessibility conformance certification

voter_harm_risk: status page cannot be used with assistive technology, keyboard navigation, high contrast, or mobile zoom
usability_floor: WCAG-oriented public status surface with perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust checks before release
required_checks: keyboard navigation; focus visibility; semantic headings; form labels; contrast; reflow/zoom; status updates announced accessibly
synthetic_status: synthetic review checklist only; no formal WCAG audit
public_boundary: The stack records an accessibility review path; it does not certify legal WCAG or ADA compliance.
non_claims: not formal WCAG conformance; not legal advice; not live authorization

voter_harm_risk: covered-language or locally needed language users receive delayed, partial, or divergent election information
usability_floor: English and required/locally supported language versions carry equivalent scope, deadlines, correction status, and official-channel pointers
required_checks: covered-language inventory; parity of dates/deadlines; translator/proofer record; oral assistance route; correction propagation
synthetic_status: generic language-access floor only; no jurisdiction-specific Section 203 determination
public_boundary: Language-access review requires local coverage and procedure confirmation; it is not a coverage determination.
non_claims: not a Section 203 coverage determination; not legal advice; not current voter instruction

voter_harm_risk: voters needing large print, braille, audio, accessible electronic formats, or other auxiliary aids cannot obtain equivalent information
usability_floor: alternative-format request path, turnaround expectation, and human assistance route are visible wherever public instructions are published
required_checks: alternative-format availability; request contact; response window; accessible electronic copy; non-retaliatory assistance language
synthetic_status: template floor only; no local auxiliary-aid authorization
public_boundary: The archive can require an alternate-format route; it is not authorization for actual local services or timing.
non_claims: not legal advice; not service authorization; not current voter instruction

voter_harm_risk: critical forms or lookup pages fail with screen readers, speech input, captions, magnification, or non-pointer input
usability_floor: representative assistive-technology smoke review is recorded before public promotion of voter-facing surfaces
required_checks: screen-reader pass; keyboard-only pass; visible focus; error message clarity; accessible authentication fallback; no pointer-only path
public_boundary: Assistive-technology smoke review is evidence of review activity, not a guarantee that every disability need is satisfied.
non_claims: not formal accessibility certification; not legal advice; not exhaustive testing

voter_harm_risk: voters who cannot use the website or automated answer surface lack a safe human route for time-sensitive help
usability_floor: public artifacts include a human help route, hours, fallback contact, and minimum-disclosure safety language
required_checks: hotline visible; hours/currentness; fallback channel; do-not-share-sensitive-data warning; escalation script reviewed
public_boundary: The archive can require a help route; it is not current contact authority until the local office validates numbers, hours, and escalation authority.
non_claims: not current contact authority; not emergency services advice; not legal advice

voter_harm_risk: emergency closures, outages, weather, security notices, or accessibility failures reach only one audience or only one language
usability_floor: emergency notices propagate across approved channels, languages, accessible text paths, and low-bandwidth copies with correction status
required_checks: channel parity; language parity; timestamp parity; accessible text copy; offline/fallback publication; correction route
reviewer_role: incident communications owner and accessibility reviewer
public_boundary: Emergency publication parity records observed publication state; it does not determine the cause of an incident.
non_claims: not proof of intent; not outcome certification; not current voter instruction unless locally authorized

voter_harm_risk: a corrected instruction is issued in English but stale translated or simplified versions remain public
usability_floor: corrections include translated/plain-language replacement status, supersession markers, and safe direction to official current channel
required_checks: superseded marker; translated correction parity; glossary consistency; old-link handling; public boundary sentence
public_boundary: Correction parity shows what replacement text should be checked; it does not certify that all live channels are current.
non_claims: not current voter instruction; not legal advice; not proof of cause

voter_harm_risk: important voter instructions in video, image, screenshot, map, or social-media media are unusable without captions, transcript, alt text, or text equivalent
usability_floor: every media-bearing public artifact has a text equivalent, caption/transcript path where applicable, digest, and source context
required_checks: alt text; transcript/captions; media source context; image text duplicated in body; no screenshot-only instruction
public_boundary: Media text equivalents improve usability but do not establish that a social-media post is official current authority.
non_claims: not current authority; not platform verification; not legal advice

voter_harm_risk: map-only, geolocation-dependent, or complex location pages hide accessible entrances, transit, curbside, vote-center, or wait-time instructions
usability_floor: location information has text list fallback, accessible-route notes, date/time scope, and non-geolocation lookup path
required_checks: text fallback; accessible entrance note; no geolocation-only flow; date/time scope; location change correction; hotline fallback
reviewer_role: polling-place operations lead and accessibility reviewer
public_boundary: Location accessibility language must be locally verified; it is not current polling-place instruction until authorized.
non_claims: not current polling-place instruction; not ADA compliance certification; not legal advice

voter_harm_risk: AI-assisted translation, simplification, or summarization changes deadlines, eligibility, legal boundaries, or safety instructions
usability_floor: AI-assisted public language requires human approval, source-text parity, prohibited-use checks, and no PII in prompts
required_checks: source text identified; human approver; translator/proofer where needed; PII prompt check; no eligibility/legal determination by AI
public_boundary: AI may assist drafting only after named human review; it must not make rights-affecting or legal determinations.
non_claims: not automated legal advice; not eligibility determination; not current voter instruction

voter_harm_risk: safety or intimidation guidance is inaccessible, untranslated, overclaims, or lacks a safe escalation path
usability_floor: safety guidance uses plain language, minimum disclosure, emergency boundary, human help route, and language/accessibility review
required_checks: safe escalation route; minimum disclosure; multilingual/plain-language review; not legal conclusion; public boundary sentence
public_boundary: Safety public answers route help and preserve evidence; they do not adjudicate allegations or replace emergency services.
non_claims: not legal advice; not emergency services replacement; not proof of intimidation

voter_harm_risk: users with low bandwidth, shared devices, outages, or limited digital access cannot obtain the same public answer
usability_floor: public summaries include printable/offline text, share-safe link guidance, low-bandwidth fallback, and digest/check date
required_checks: printable text copy; no login required; share-safe link; check date; digest; fallback channel
public_boundary: Offline copies must point back to refreshed official authority; they are not current voter instructions unless locally authorized.
non_claims: not current voter instruction; not live authorization; not legal advice

voter_harm_risk: release process treats privacy-reviewed evidence as publishable even when voters cannot read, access, or safely act on it
usability_floor: all public-facing release candidates have local accessibility/language review, exception handling, and no-go notice before publication
required_checks: policy matrix closed; local approvals or exceptions; public/private separation inherited; source freshness; human help fallback
reviewer_role: public release owner, accessibility reviewer, and language-access lead
synthetic_status: synthetic no-go only; no local accessibility or language approval
public_boundary: The accessibility/language gate is a release-safety control; it is not legal advice or conformance certification.
non_claims: not legal advice; not accessibility certification; not language-coverage determination; not live deployment evidence
